name: seniorvibes
description: Senior devs vibe coding — one-line directives become grounded code blocks.

seniorvibes.sentinel.markdownDescription: Trigger token that marks the rest of a line as a directive. May appear after existing code on the line. Regex-escaped automatically.

seniorvibes.ollama.endpoint.description: Base URL of the local Ollama server.

seniorvibes.ollama.model.description: Ollama model used for generation. Pull it first, e.g. `ollama pull qwen2.5-coder`.

seniorvibes.context.linesAbove.description: Lines of code above the directive sent as context.

seniorvibes.context.linesBelow.description: Lines of code below the insertion point sent as context.

seniorvibes.highlight.style.markdownDescription: How to briefly mark freshly generated code. `foreground` recolors the text (overrides syntax colors until it clears); `background` tints behind it (keeps syntax colors); `none` disables it.

seniorvibes.highlight.color.description: Highlight color (any CSS color). Empty uses a sensible default per style.

seniorvibes.highlight.durationMs.description: How long the highlight stays before the code returns to normal. 0 disables it.

seniorvibes.directive.removeAfterGenerat.markdownDescription: After a successful generation, remove the directive line(s) after a delay, leaving only the generated code. Skipped if your cursor is on the directive when the timer fires.

seniorvibes.directive.removeDelayMs.description: Delay before the directive line is auto-removed. 0 keeps the directive.

seniorvibes.grounding.enabled.markdownDescription: Resolve symbols named in the directive (e.g. `NotFoundException`, `inviteService`) to their real signatures via the language server, and feed them to the model as ground truth.

seniorvibes.grounding.maxSymbols.description: Maximum number of grounded symbol signatures to include per generation.

scripts.verify: npm run check-types && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run compile
